ready1_open_rewrite.title: MM-Math open-ended problem
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: As shown in the figure, points $A$, $O$, and $B$ are on the same line, $OC$ bisects $\angle AOB$. If $\angle COD = 28^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle BOD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.expected_answer: \textbf{Solution:} Since points $A$, $O$, and $B$ lie on the same line, and $OC$ bisects $\angle AOB$, \\ $\therefore$ $\angle AOC=\angle BOC=90^\circ$, \\ $\therefore$ $\angle BOD=\angle BOC-\angle COD=90^\circ-28^\circ=\boxed{62^\circ}$.
